messages:
PagerDuty Bot: :rotating_light: Incident triggered: r-inference-gateway-eu-west1 - error-rate > 5% (5xx) - PD#INC-3429 - paging oncall
Alex Kim: acked incident on PD, jumping in. seeing alerts in grafana now. working hypothesis: sudden cache flood causing backend 502s
PagerDuty Bot: Incident assigned to alex.kim@redwood (primary oncall)
Alex Kim: quick snapshot: 5xx spiking across gateway frontends in eu-west1 since ~03:10 UTC. traces show large number of requests with empty KV cache misses and many concurrent cold fetches to model-backend.
Alex Kim: posting logs snippet:
```
[03:11:12] gateway: proxy -> model-backend 502 response, id=ab12f4, route=/v1/generate
[03:11:12] gateway: kvcache MISS key=ctx-xyz size=0
[03:11:13] model-backend: connection queue full, reject
```
Maya Patel: @Alex any immediate mitigation we can flip? Canary of fallback model variant? More rate-limiting?
Alex Kim: trying to enable cheap fallback routing to small-capacity dedicated pool (dedicated-quant-small) to absorb cold-starts. also increasing gateway rate limiter to drop large bursts from a few noisy customers.
Paul Rivers: I can nudge autoscaler for model-backend pods but need to avoid thundering herd. Suggest gradual scale + increase request queue len
Nina Ortega: Oncall Bot — can we temporarily disable KV invalidation broadcast? last deploy rolled out an invalidation change earlier today.
Oncall Bot: KV invalidation broadcast toggle available at /ops/kv-config — requires engineer approval
Alex Kim: toggled invalidation-broadcast to OFF (manual). Observing drop in concurrent backend fetches.
PagerDuty Bot: User alex.kim acknowledged, status: investigating
Maya Patel: running quick health probes:
```
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://gateway-eu-west1.redwood.ai/health
```
Maya Patel: health okay on frontends but backend latency still high for some paths
Paul Rivers: scaled model-backend deployment from 8 -> 14 replicas (kubectl scale --replicas=14 deploy/model-backend-eu)
Alex Kim: adding temporary circuit-breaker rule to gateway so any client > 30 req/s gets 429 for 60s. command pasted in infra chatops.
Nina Ortega: reaching out to top affected customer accounts for status check. early signals: 2 enterprise customers saw intermittent 502s and timeouts on batch embedding calls
Maya Patel: rolling restart of a subset of model-backend pods to clear stuck connections (kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-backend-eu --min-available=50%)
Alex Kim: after invalidation-broadcast toggled off and scale/CB changes, 5xx rate dropped from 6.8% -> 1.2% in last 4m. still monitoring. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty Bot: Alert: PD#INC-3429 updated - status: partial_mitigation
Paul Rivers: note: backend queue_full logs correlate with a specific client pattern sending many small parallel requests. I've added a temporary per-client concurrency limiter at edge.
Maya Patel: checkpoint for customer impact: small window of errors for some batch jobs; realtime chat/QA features experienced latency spikes, but no data loss reported. CS notified and started customer emails.
Alex Kim: next action: keep invalidation-broadcast off, keep CB in place for 30m, monitor 5xx for 15m. If stable, begin controlled roll-forward of the earlier invalidation change to a subset of zones with canary.
Nina Ortega: handing off to night oncall in 25m. Will prepare runbook note and handover message.
Oncall Bot: Reminder — postmortem created draft at /incidents/INC-3429/draft
Maya Patel: adding a quick runbook snippet for the handoff:
- symptom: sudden 5xx spike due to KV cache cold-miss storm after invalidation broadcast
- immediate mitigations: toggle invalidation-broadcast OFF, scale model-backend, apply gateway circuit-breaker, per-client concurrency limiter
- signals to watch: 5xx rate, backend queue_full logs, KV cache miss rate, top-client request rates
Alex Kim: leaving logs & commands used in thread so next oncall can repro steps. ping me if it flaps back.
Nina Ortega: handing off to Paul Rivers for overnight oncall. pauls@pageduty
Paul Rivers: ack handoff, will take over monitoring. please DM if you want to escalate. updating PD status: acknowledged by paul.rivers
PagerDuty Bot: PD#INC-3429 - acknowledged by paul.rivers - escalation paused
Alex Kim: thanks team. will follow up in postmortem with root cause (likely misbehaving invalidation broadcast causing fanout). :coffee:
Maya Patel: +1 to postmortem, capture timeline and customer impact notes
Nina Ortega: closing eyes on this side. good work everyone. :team-heart:
Paul Rivers: keeping watch. will escalate to infra if 5xx > 2% for 10m.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident PD#INC-3429 - last update: partial mitigation, assigned to paul.rivers for overnight monitoring
